{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Earth Horse|kanji=戊午|romaji=tsuchinoe uma|onyomi=bogo|p=wùwǔ|w=wu-wu|mi=u⁵⁵ u²¹|y=mou6 ng5|j=mou6 ng5|ci=mɐu ŋo|mc=məu ŋo|oc-bs=mə ŋaʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Earth Horse''' (戊午, ''tsuchinoe uma''; onyomi ''bogo'') is the 55th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 55th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Fire Snake|ja|丁巳|1=Yin Fire Snake}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Earth Goat|ja|己未|1=Yin Earth Goat}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''戊'' is Yang Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''午'' (Horse) is Yang Fire; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Earth Horse (戊午)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): wùwǔ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): mou6 ng5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoe-uma
*** On'yomi: bogo
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): muo (무오)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Mậu Ngọ

==Months of Yang Earth Horse==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 3 or 8 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Gui|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Bo|ja|戊|1=Tsuchinoe (戊)|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bo}}), the month of {{ill|May|en|May|qid=Q119|lt=May|1=May}} is designated as the Bokugo {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month|1=Month}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Mangzhong|en|Mangzhong|qid=Q1147880|lt=Mangzhong|1=Mangzhong}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaoshu|en|Xiaoshu|qid=Q1190976|lt=Slightly Hot|1=Xiaoshu}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Earth Horse==
The {{ill|selected day|ja|選日|1=Senjitsu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for Bokugo is as follows.
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
Bokugo day is the gap day of {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}}.
